cases.name: AC-1: subtract importable and defined in src/app_int/main.py
cases.detail: uv run python -c 'from app_int.main import subtract; inspect.getsourcefile(subtract)' -> .../src/app_int/main.py. Import succeeded.

cases.name: AC-2: signature is (a, b), positional-or-keyword, no defaults
cases.detail: inspect.signature(subtract) -> (a: 'int', b: 'int') -> 'int'. tests/test_main.py::test_subtract_signature asserts names == ['a','b'], kind POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD, default empty: passed.

cases.name: AC-4: negative, zero and negative-operand cases
cases.detail: Direct calls: subtract(2,5)=-3, (0,0)=0, (7,0)=7, (-4,-6)=2, (-3,2)=-5. test_subtract_returns_negative_difference and test_subtract_edge_cases passed.

cases.name: AC-5: annotations are int for a, b and return
cases.detail: subtract.__annotations__ == {'a': 'int', 'b': 'int', 'return': 'int'} (string form because of from __future__ import annotations, which the AC accepts). test_subtract_annotations_are_int passed.

cases.name: AC-6: subtract.__doc__ is a non-empty string
cases.detail: subtract.__doc__ == 'Return the difference of two integers (a minus b).'. test_subtract_has_docstring passed.

cases.name: AC-7: health_check and add unchanged, existing tests kept and passing
cases.detail: health_check() -> {'status': 'ok'}, add(2, 3) -> 5. test_health_check_reports_ok and test_add_returns_the_sum are unchanged in tests/test_main.py and pass.

cases.name: AC-8: a test imports subtract from app_int.main and asserts on its return value
cases.detail: QA added the tests (the Developer's write scope excludes tests/). tests/test_main.py now has 'from app_int.main import add, health_check, subtract' and 6 subtract tests that assert on return values.

cases.name: AC-9: tests have positive and negative expected results, so a b - a mutant fails
cases.detail: Positive: subtract(5,3)==2. Negative: subtract(2,5)==-3. Mutation check: replaced app_int.main.subtract with a 'return b - a' version in memory and ran the value tests. test_subtract_returns_positive_difference, test_subtract_returns_negative_difference and test_subtract_edge_cases all raised AssertionError.

cases.name: AC-11: uv run ruff check . exits 0
cases.detail: Output: 'All checks passed!', exit code 0 (with the new tests in place).

cases.name: AC-12: pyproject.toml dependencies unchanged from base branch
cases.detail: git diff main -- pyproject.toml printed nothing, so the file is identical to main.
